intersection.headline: Nike and Formula 1 announce long-term global partnership, with a Las Vegas Grand Prix capsule collection as a preview
intersection.summary: Nike has signed a multi-year global partnership with F1, with the deal starting fully in 2027. It covers product, innovation, design and race-weekend experiences, including F1 uniforms and F1 Academy apparel. A limited-edition Las Vegas Grand Prix x Nike capsule launched on 20 November at the F1 Hub and Nike retail locations in Las Vegas. More product and experience details are due later.

sports.headline: Kansas City Current win first NWSL Championship, beating Washington Spirit 2-1
sports.summary: Kansas City won the franchise's first NWSL title at Audi Field on 21 November. Vanessa DiBernardo scored an Olimpico (a goal direct from a corner) and Debinha added a second late on. Trinity Rodman pulled one back in stoppage time, so the Spirit lost a third straight final. ESPN notes it was the seventh different franchise to win the title.

sports.headline: FIFA's $1.5B 2030 World Cup US rights push faces a shrinking field as major networks exit
sports.summary: Several major US networks and streamers have pulled out of bidding for the 2030 men's World Cup rights, including ESPN, NBCUniversal and YouTube. That leaves Fox (in a joint bid with Univision) and Netflix as the leading contenders. FIFA wants more than $1.5bn and aims to choose a winner by the end of the year. This follows a record-viewership 2026 tournament.

sports.headline: Verstappen wins Las Vegas Grand Prix in slipstream thriller
sports.summary: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix by 0.6s from Lando Norris after the lead changed hands repeatedly with Mercedes' George Russell and Kimi Antonelli. Oscar Piastri completed a double McLaren podium. The report is from Planet F1, and I could not reconcile the championship standings across the sources I found.

fashion.headline: Dior names Stray Kids' Hyunjin as brand ambassador
fashion.summary: WWD reports exclusively that the K-pop star will represent Dior's beauty division and the collections designed by Jonathan Anderson. He joins a roster that includes BTS's Jimin. WWD frames the move as part of Asian celebrities' continued dominance in generating earned media value for luxury brands.

marketing.headline: Adidas crowned Brand of the Year at the 2026 Marketing Week Awards; Lloyds' Suresh Balaji named Marketer of the Year
marketing.summary: Adidas won Brand of the Year for its bounce-back, ahead of Allica Bank, Currys, Nationwide, Tony's Chocolonely and Waitrose. Lucky Saint and Anthropic were also big winners. Mother took Agency of the Year and Paddy Power was named Marketing Team of the Year. Lloyds CMO Suresh Balaji was named Marketer of the Year.

marketing.headline: Patricia Oliva promoted to CMO of Danone USA
marketing.summary: Oliva, a Danone veteran of nearly 25 years, takes over Danone USA's marketing organisation. Her remit covers brand growth, consumer demand, innovation and marketing capabilities. She was previously Category General Manager for US Beverages, Plant-Based & Marketing Excellence.

marketing.headline: Future of Marketing Briefing: consulting firms revive their marketing ambitions in the C-suite the holdcos covet
marketing.summary: Digiday analyses how firms such as Deloitte are pitching 'brand to cash' systems that need sign-off above the CMO. It also covers how AI is moving marketing decisions into rooms where the CFO and CIO sit. The analysis looks at what this means for agency holding companies and for the CMO's role.
